Overview

New York City is a city in NY with a population of 8,335,897. The global capital of finance, culture, and opportunity — but it comes with the highest cost of living in the US. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
